findings.claim: n8n 2.47.7 is a non-prerelease release published on 2026-11-13 and tagged at commit d4dcb1b152a98fc31ea7c4ee6aecdc45c5c88063.
findings.notes: Version pin for this snapshot; not a claim this remains latest in perpetuity.

findings.claim: The tagged workflow structural validator checks nodes and connections, names/IDs, references and shape but does not check installed node type, parameter correctness, credential validity or activation readiness.
findings.notes: Inspected entire source file; comments explicitly identify excluded checks.

findings.claim: Native input structural validation requires name, type and position per node while accepting omitted id, typeVersion and parameters, but INode TypeScript interface requires the latter fields.
findings.notes: Also inspect packages/workflow/src/interfaces.ts INode; this is not proof of every endpoint DTO.

findings.claim: The n8n node OnError enum supports continueErrorOutput, continueRegularOutput and stopWorkflow.
findings.notes: Type declaration inspected; runtime semantics not yet exercised.

findings.claim: Connection map limit MAX_CONNECTION_INDEX is 1000 and MAX_DESTINATION_INPUT_SLOTS is 100000 in the tagged source.
findings.notes: Source inspected; not all runtime graph limits audited.

findings.claim: The n8n helper validateWorkflowHasTriggerLikeNode checks for recognized non-disabled polling, trigger or webhook-capable nodes.
findings.notes: A helper, not the entire publication validator pipeline.

findings.claim: n8n docs describe sub-workflows using Execute Workflow and Execute Sub-workflow Trigger, including explicit input-field and JSON-example input modes.
findings.notes: Live official documentation; recheck for target version.

findings.claim: n8n official error-handling docs state an error workflow begins with the Error Trigger, may be reused and receives different data for trigger-node failures.
findings.notes: Official docs, not an exhaustive runtime matrix.

findings.claim: n8n official docs warn exported workflow JSON can contain credential names/IDs and HTTP Request auth headers.
findings.notes: Apply sanitation before sharing any exported artifact.

findings.claim: Official n8n environment tutorial says Git push uses saved workflow versions and remote publication is separate; native source-control environments are Business/Enterprise features.
findings.notes: Edition availability may change; confirm on the target account.

findings.claim: Official queue-mode docs describe main instance, Redis and worker instances and note filesystem binary storage is unsupported in queue mode.
findings.notes: Also documented: workers need shared encryption key; verify deployment settings.

findings.claim: The community n8n-MCP README claims 3501 nodes, 2352 templates, workflow validation/testing, snapshot support and multi-instance integration.
findings.notes: Figures and functional claims are self-reported. README references n8n 2.46.7; audit target compatibility.

findings.claim: REA README advertises analysis of JavaScript/Electron and native applications via MCP and CLI.
findings.notes: Tool not installed or run in this documentation baseline.

findings.claim: Programmatic-style node creators may need to set pairedItem to preserve item lineage for downstream expressions.
findings.notes: Need Code-node and sub-node variants tested independently.

findings.claim: All production changes should require independent staging verification and an explicit production release approval policy.
findings.notes: Project-specific safety policy, not a native n8n constraint.
